entry_command:
python3 -m pip install --quiet magnus-sdk==0.8.2
python3 - <<'LLP_PROBE'
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,shutil,urllib.request
import magnus
p=magnus.download_file('magnus-secret:28603-angel-live-lease',target_path="/magnus/workspace/payload.txt")
assert pathlib.Path(p).read_text()=="LLP-AGI deployment roundtrip; no physics events.\n"
r={"success":True,"tool":'micromegas',"sdk":magnus.__version__,"physics_events":0}
assert json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(os.environ["MAGNUS_ADDRESS"]+"/health").read())["status"]=="ok"
assert pathlib.Path("/opt/micromegas_6.3.0").is_dir()
r["micromegas"]="6.3.0"
r["compiler"]=subprocess.check_output(["gcc","--version"],text=True).splitlines()[0]
out=pathlib.Path("/magnus/workspace/probe.json")
out.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
secret=magnus.custody_file(str(out),max_downloads=3)
pathlib.Path(os.environ["MAGNUS_RESULT"]).write_text(json.dumps({"success":True,"output":secret}))

LLP_PROBE
